summary: Two author-owned frozen-plan facts are internally inconsistent: the M per-run budget is 2,000D in four governing locations but 10,000D in the synthetic-suite specification, and the H1 graph-recovery endpoint is fixed-checkpoint median NMI in four governing locations but first-activation/time-weighted NMI in the synthetic-suite specification.

findings.required_decision: Author must choose the governing M per-run budget before any optimizer/config/red contract is prepared.

findings.majority_candidate: NMI at fixed 25/50/75/100 percent budget checkpoints; problem-level median
findings.conflicting_value: NMI at first valid activation and time-weighted median over later valid graphs
findings.impact: The two definitions observe different times and apply different aggregation, so they can produce different H1 values and branch decisions from the same runs.
findings.required_decision: Author must choose the governing H1 endpoint before analysis/run-bundle fields or red contracts are prepared.

findings.detail: The 2,000D and fixed-checkpoint formulations are majority candidates, not an author-confirmed resolution. Consistency tooling must not auto-select them.

The current .light consistency registry does not register budget or H1 timing/aggregation as canonical semantic objects, so the general text scan returned WARN rather than detecting these numeric/definition conflicts.

recommended_author_choice.rationale: It is repeated in the plan, preregistration and failure tree, and exactly reproduces the frozen 52,920,000 M-FFE and 270,120,000 core total. Choosing 10,000D would increase M by 211,680,000 FFE and require recomputing the frozen totals.
recommended_author_choice.H1_endpoint: fixed 25/50/75/100 percent checkpoints with problem-level median NMI
recommended_author_choice.rationale_H1: It is repeated in the plan, preregistration, experiment matrix and failure tree and is directly tied to the frozen success/failure analysis.

blocked_artifact.reason: Its proposed red contracts cannot be specified unambiguously until the M budget and H1 endpoint are author-resolved and frozen through a versioned amendment.

required_route: Prepare a hash-bound author decision candidate for the two conflicts; after author selection, create a versioned amendment candidate, preserve the original frozen snapshot, freeze the amendment under a separate acceptance, then issue a new S6-E0 red-phase authorization candidate bound to the amended plan.
actions_not_taken: No canonical value was auto-selected or written to .light/consistency.
No S6-E0 specification, fixture, test or production module was created.
No optimizer, evaluator, benchmark, simulation or formal FFE was executed.
